Software Engineering: Foundation Course (SENG-101)

Objective

The foundation course is designed to provide a solid introduction to the world of Software Engineering by exposing participants to core concepts, knowledge and skills required to succeed as Software Engineers.

Duration

This course runs for a total duration of 27 hours (26 paid hours + 1 FREE hour).

Prerequisites

To participate in this course, students only need to be familiar with how to operate a computer system, use the input devices such as keyboard and mouse, as well as be familiar with how to access information on the Internet.

Certification

Upon successful completion of this course, participants will be awarded the “iSTEMLabsAfrica Software Engineering: Foundation Course” certificate.

Cost

The cost of this course is N52,000 (Fifty-Two Thousand Naira Only).

Course Content

  1. 1hr - iSTEMLabsAfrica Digital Awareness Health Check (FREE)
  2. 4hrs - Linux O/S Part I
    • Introduction to the Terminal/Shell
    • Navigating in Linux and common commands
    • Working with Files and Folders
    • File Permissions, Redirection and Piping
  3. 1hr - Project A: ???
  4. 4hrs - Linux O/S Part II
    • Using Text Editors
    • Environment Variables
    • SSH - Key pairs, ssh connection, scp
  5. 1hr - Project B: ???
  6. 4hrs - Version Control with Git
    • Git Everyday commands
  7. 1hr - Project C: ???
    • 4hrs - Git in the Cloud
    • Github.com Setup
    • Bitbucket.org Setup
    • Gitlab.com Setup
  8. 1hr - Project D: ???
  9. 4hrs - Introduction to Shell Scripting with Bash
  10. 2hrs - Capstone Project: Write a shell script to automatically list out untouched downloaded files consuming space on the drive using a text editor.
